- llama: update llama.cpp to b11521 for decision models and EmbeddingGemma 2 by @jmorganca in #18917

- server: reuse verified manifests and loaded models in inference routes by @dhiltgen in #18947

- mlx: compact restored recurrent state after speculative rollback by @dhiltgen in #18955

- launch: include installed models in Codex /model picker by @ParthSareen in #18887

- MLX, MLX-C: version bump by @dhiltgen in #18956

Full Changelog : v0.40.3...v0.40.4-rc1
summaryZh: Ollama 发布了 v0.40.4 版本，将底层 llama.cpp 升级至 b11521，支持决策模型和 EmbeddingGemma 2。此外，该版本优化了服务端推理路由以复用验证清单和已加载模型，并在推测回滚后压缩 MLX 恢复的循环状态。

aiReview.reasonZh: Ollama 发布日常小版本更新，集成了更新的底层 llama.cpp 支持及 MLX 状态恢复优化。
